welcome.title: Welcome to PattaPehchan
welcome.intro: PattaPehchan helps you understand land records, check a property before you buy or sell, and work out inheritance shares, in plain words.
welcome.sizeHint: The whole page changes so you can see it. You can change this later.

bottomBar.title: Bottom bar
bottomBar.body: The four buttons at the bottom take you to Home, Search, Calculator and Track.

welcome.holdTip: Tip: on a computer, point at an icon. On a phone, press and hold it. You will see what it does.
welcome.laterNote: You can change all of this later: tap the gear icon, called Settings, at the top of any page.

tip.language: Change the language of the whole site at any time. You stay on the same page.
tip.help: Explains the legal words used on this site. This page is coming soon.
tip.settings: Make the text bigger, switch on high contrast, or turn on the audio guide. Your choices are saved on this phone.
